content: विकृ €8 <ab>U.</ab> ²1 To alter, change, affect; विकारहेतौ सति विक्रियन्ते येषां न चेतांसि त एव धीराः <ls>Ku. 1. 59</ls>; <ls>R. 13. 42</ls>. .²2 To disfigure, deform; विकृताकृति <ls>Ms. 9. 52</ls>. .²3 To create, produce, effect; मनः सृष्टिं विकुरुते चोद्यमानं सिसृक्षया <ls>Ms. 1. 75</ls>; नास्य विघ्नं विकुर्वन्ति दानवाः <ls>Mb.</ls> .²4 To disturb, harm, injure (<ab>Ā.</ab>); हीनान्यनुपकर्तॄणि प्रवृद्धानि विकुर्वते <ls>R. 17. 58</ls>. .²5 To utter (a sound); विकुर्वाणः स्वरानद्य <ls>Bk. 8. 20</ls>. .²6 To be faithless (as a wife.). .²7 To deprave, pervert, spoil. .²8 To display. .²9 To change for the worse, deteriorate (<ab>Ā.</ab>). .²10 To rejoice (<ab>Ā.</ab>). .²11 To feel aversion (<ab>Ā.</ab>). .²12 To act in various ways (<ab>Ā.</ab>); विकुर्वन्तश्च तैः साकम् <ls>Bhāg. 10. 12. 9</ls>. .²13 To decorate in various ways; प्रासादैः रत्नविकृतैः <ls>Rām. 1. 5. 15</ls>. .²14 To exercise. .²15 To distribute. .²16 To destroy, ruin. .²17 To spread, extend. .²18 To become restless, move to and fro. .²19 To act in a hostile manner. .²20 To contend together. .²21 To blame, revile; अनार्य इति मामार्याः … विकरिष्यन्ति रथ्यासु <ls>Rām. 2. 12. 78</ls>.
